facts.fact: KRAY 说 Chief Wacker 让他为 Project GOOWIKI 制定计划。
facts.anchor: Chief Wacker asked me to put together a plan for Project GOOWIKI.

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说 HR 不做招聘；她的全名是 Evita P. EVERSHAG。
facts.anchor: “HR doesn’t do hiring,” EVERSHAG said. Her full Funny Name was Evita P. EVERSHAG.

facts.fact: HR 很久不介入，直到三年试用期结束、首次评估到期才参与。
facts.anchor: “Oh not for a long time not until the first evaluation is due when the probationary period is over three years.”

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说政府里没人会被解雇。
七个月前 KRAY 被派到塞浦路斯执行对线人 DQFLOPSWEAT/7 的终止会面；此人是希族塞浦路斯人，两年间只领小额月津贴。
facts.anchor: Seven months earlier, KRAY had been tasked with carrying out an agent termination meeting in Cyprus. DQFLOPSWEAT/7, a Greek Cypriot recruited to report on movements of Russian mob money in and out of the island, hadn’t panned out after two years on the books collecting a small monthly stipend.

facts.fact: KRAY 提出把最终付款提到四百美元，其中两百美元是他自己的钱。
facts.anchor: “Look, I’ll make it four hundred,” said KRAY. “Including two hundred of my own money.

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说机构在过去十一年里用过七套不同的评估系统。
facts.anchor: the Agency has had seven different evaluation systems in the last eleven years

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 突然问 KRAY 是不是在和 KANDINSKY 约会，KRAY 承认是。
facts.anchor:
“You’re going out with KANDINSKY aren’t you?” EVERSHAG said out of the blue.

“Yes, I am,” said KRAY, surprised at the question.
